definitions.explanation: A cat that has been abandoned by its owner, or one left to live without a home. Often used when the cat is found and taken in.

examples.japanese: {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}を{拾|ひろ}った。
examples.english: I picked up an abandoned cat.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}に{捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}がいた。
examples.english: There was an abandoned cat in the park.

examples.japanese: {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}を{保護|ほご}して{里親|さとおや}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: We've taken in an abandoned cat and are looking for someone to adopt it.

notes:
Composed of {捨|す}てる (to throw away, abandon) + {猫|ねこ} (cat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}を{拾|ひろ}う: to pick up an abandoned cat
- {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}を{保護|ほご}する: to rescue or take in an abandoned cat
- {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}を{飼|か}う: to keep an abandoned cat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {野良猫|のらねこ}: stray cat — one living wild on its own; {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ} stresses that the cat was abandoned by an owner.
